{{Current events|year=2021|month=12|day=28|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Iran–Israel conflict during the Syrian civil war]]
**[[Syria]]n [[Syrian Arab News Agency|state media]] reports that [[Israel]] has bombed the [[Port of Latakia]]. If this is confirmed by the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]], it would be the second [[airstrike]] on the facility this month. Secondary [[explosion]]s are believed to be from [[Iran]]ian [[munition]]s stored at the facility. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israeli-airstrikes-said-to-hit-key-syrian-port-of-latakia-causing-massive-damage/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**Massive damage at the port is reported from the air raid with most of the port on fire, although there are no immediate reports of casualties from the attack. Videos on [[social media]] show multiple large explosions and [[anti-aircraft warfare|anti-aircraft fire]] over the city. A hospital, shops, and some residential buildings were also badly damaged. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/28/israeli-air-raid-targets-syrian-port-of-latakia-state-media  (Al Jazeera English)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 38 people are killed in the collapse of a private [[Gold mining|gold mine]] in [[En Nahud]], [[Sudan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/29/sudan-gold-mine-collapse-kills-dozens (Al Jazeera English)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Delhi]]
*****[[Delhi]] enters Level 1 "Yellow alert" which closes cinemas, schools, colleges, and gyms, imposes a nighttime [[curfew]] from 10 pm to 5 am, and restricts the capacity of public transport, restaurants, funerals and weddings, due to an increase in the number of [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron variant]] cases. [https://www.timesofindia.com/city/delhi/night-curfew-in-delhi-from-10pm-to-5am-after-yellow-alert-sounded-under-grap-in-view-of-rising-covid-19-cases/articleshow/88542705.cms (''The Times of India'')]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in India]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
*****The [[Ministry of Health and Family Welfare]] issues emergency use authorizations for the [[Novavax COVID-19 vaccine|Covovax]] vaccine manufactured by the [[Serum Institute of India]] and the Corbevax vaccine. The ministry also issues an emergency use authorization for [[Merck & Co.]]'s anti-viral drug [[Molnupiravir]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/sci-tech/health/corbevax-covovax-molnupiravir-approved-for-restricted-emergency-use-against-covid-19/article38053695.ece (''The Hindu'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] begins administering [[booster dose]]s of the [[COVID-19]] vaccine for people over the age of 60 and frontline workers who have been fully vaccinated more than six months ago as the country attempts to reduce the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/2021/12/28/bangladesh-rolls-out-covid-vaccine-booster-doses (''Bdnews24.com'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]] issues stay-at home orders for hundreds of thousands of people in [[Yan'an]] due to the spread of COVID-19 cases, which also resulted in a [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in [[Xi'an]], the country's largest lockdown since last year. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211228-china-expands-lockdowns-as-virus-surges-in-us-europe (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a person who travelled from the [[United Kingdom]] on December 19. [https://e.vnexpress.net/news/news/vietnam-confirms-first-omicron-infection-4409195.html (''VnExpress International'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****[[Cyprus]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 2,241 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 154,926. [https://www.financialmirror.com/2021/12/28/covid19-cases-surge-to-new-record-2241/ (''Financial Mirror'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports a record 179,807 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20211229-france-reports-record-high-of-almost-180-000-new-covid-cases-in-24-hours (Radio France Internationale)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 21,657 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,105,885. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1174596/greece-sets-pandemic-record-for-new-cases-with-whopping-21-657/amp/ (''Kathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record 78,313 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/20211229/46d5171f53724b49a853bba6a9fbc8b4/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record 17,172 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,303,291. [https://www.theportugalnews.com/news/2021-12-28/covid-19-portugal-update-28-december/64365 (''The Portugal News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] reports a record 138,831 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2021/dec/28/uk-new-record-daily-covid-cases (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] reports 8,825 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of cases since March 2020 to 715,405. [https://toronto.ctvnews.ca/ontario-reports-8-825-new-covid-19-cases-seven-deaths-1.5721081 (CFTO-DT)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] becomes the first [[U.S. state]] and the world's first subnational entity to surpass five million cases of COVID-19. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/california-1st-state-top-5m-cases-amid-omicron-81974344 (ABC News)]
****The [[United States]] reports a record 512,553 new COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours. [https://deadline.com/2021/12/united-states-covid-cases-daily-record-1234902298/ (''Deadline Hollywood'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[South Africa]] postpones a plan to end COVID-19 [[contact tracing]] and suspend some quarantine measures in order to consider additional comments about the policy after the government received many inquiries about the plan. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-12-28/south-africa-pauses-plan-to-scrap-covid-19-contact-tracing (Bloomberg News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russian police]] arrest two allies of [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|opposition]] politician and activist [[Alexei Navalny]], Kseniya Fadeyeva and Zakhar Sarapulov, under [[extremism]] [[criminal charge|charges]]. [[Leonid Volkov (politician)|Leonid Volkov]], another ally of Navalny, had tried to persuade Fadeyeva and Sarapulov to leave [[Russia]] as he and others have done, but they refused. [https://www.barrons.com/amp/news/russia-raids-homes-of-navalny-s-former-associates-allies-01640697608 (''Barron's'')]
*The [[Supreme Court of Russia]] orders the liquidation of [[human rights in Russia|human rights]] group [[Memorial (society)|Memorial]] for violating the [[Russian foreign agent law]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-59808624 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Social Democratic Union of Macedonia]] leader [[Dimitar Kovačevski]] is confirmed as [[North Macedonia]]'s [[Prime Minister of North Macedonia|Prime Minister-designate]] following the [[resignation]] of [[Zoran Zaev]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/north-macedonia-confirms-new-socialists-leader-pm-designate-2021-12-28/ (Reuters)]
